label: RULE 1
head: He refuses to rust
sub: Clothes that fit, intentional grooming, straight posture. Not for her. For him.

label: RULE 2
head: He doesn't audition
sub: No name-dropping, no reciting his resume. Warm room or cold room, same guy.

label: RULE 3
head: He's the shoreline
sub: Something irritates you? Wait 5 seconds before you answer.

items.head: Her bad day isn't about him
items.sub: He doesn't sulk or soak up her mood. He stays steady.

items.head: Present, not performing
items.sub: He's in the moment with her, not stuck in his head.

label: RULE 6
head: He doesn't silently fold
sub: He says what doesn't work for him. Calmly, once. That's what keeps her respect.

label: RULE 7
head: He travels light
sub: Old breakups stay behind. She knows in 20 minutes if she's competing with your past.

text: Your relationship with *yourself*. Not with her.
